purpose: Prospectively test autonomous one-compartment voltage-calcium-SK feedback with frozen Task27 rates, after the separate native Task30c and IV-B2 confirmations.
source_selection: Choose the source hypothesis with lowest calibration worst-episode 40ms exact-formula/native voltage RMSE. Ties choose old_state_ica. Do not use confirmation episodes for selection.
negative_control: Compare coupled calcium with a frozen-cai analytic arm. Report peak calcium and SK differences for every non-rest episode; a negligible contrast limits interpretation and cannot be presented as validated slow-feedback behavior.
decision: A model verdict is allowed only if canonical native trajectories are finite, the source hypothesis is chosen on calibration only, and the confirmation exact-formula/native floor passes all voltage and calcium thresholds. On that admissible reference, every family/seed frozen both-arm must satisfy pooled/worst 40ms voltage, calcium, SK and physical bounds. Report the 80ms horizon and frozen-cai ablation as diagnostic. If native floor fails, report solver/ordering mismatch, not a learned-model NO-GO. Passing this task supports only this one-compartment dynamic-calcium setup; it does not authorize synapses, morphology, speed or full-cell claims.
scope: One compartment, original 11 channel mechanisms plus CaDynamics_E2 in native NEURON. Autonomous voltage and cai, exogenous current, fixed reversals, no morphology, synapses, stochasticity or speed claim. Frozen five-channel neural rates; other six canonical formula rates; calcium equation and SK current remain analytic.
